$comment: Chart-form names that must not appear in an illegal-form entry's `asserted` or `cause` fields (whole-word, case-insensitive). The `colloquial` field is exempt: it exists to show the name is downstream of the cause. Doctrine invariant 1: no form name below L4. Words that are ALSO L0-L4 vocabulary (graph, area, line, polar, stack) are deliberately absent; only their form-name phrases are listed.
